title: 5100012: prove the k203,b origin-pedal area-product invariant
body:
## Result
The product of signed orbit area and signed origin-pedal area is constant for primitive periods that are odd or divisible by4 in a nondegenerate strictly nested confocal ellipse pair. Primitive star trajectories are included. The pedal feet are on consecutive billiard side lines; no hyperbolic-caustic or parity-by-repetition extension is asserted.

## Review and reproducibility
Separate uninvolved full adversarial AI review passed with no mathematical correction. Frozen proof SHA256:d1e04cf42d4358243365969487348887f3451f9b3fcef63b5215e7389af0e039. Author37,393 and independent13,712 exact controls passed;4,092 and348 separate numerical diagnostics are not formal certificates or substitutes for the universal argument.

Stachel's canonical theorem and classical Jacobi/complex methods are credited. A shared author contribution toward neighboring k203,a is explicitly disclosed; it is not presented as independent review. This proof establishes the origin-only target, including odd periods, without assuming the neighboring arbitrary-M result. No historical novelty or human peer review claimed.
